title: Thai Fish Nimono
description: Delicately flavored Thai fish curry made with nimono ingredients, perfect for a quick dinner.
instructions: Heat 2 tbsp of oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add the Thai red curry paste and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the fish fillets and cook for 2-3 minutes per side, until cooked through.
Add the nimono, garlicky sauce, coconut milk, fish sauce, and sugar to the pan.
Stir to combine and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let the curry simmer for 5-7 minutes, until the sauce has thickened.
Stir in the Thai basil and serve the curry over rice or noodles.
